experiment.topic: Hourly trend persistence in BTC-USD across market regimes
experiment.hypothesis: A 20-hour upward trend in BTC-USD persists for at least 4 additional hours when the 20-hour standard deviation exceeds 5% and the market regime remains stable.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: In a randomly selected 20-hour period from 2020 to present, if the 20-hour standard deviation of BTC-USD hourly closes exceeds 5%, and the market regime remains stable, then a subsequent 4-hour upward trend must occur. If no such trend occurs in at least 100 such cases, the hypothesis is falsified.
